# Sciorex

> Sciorex is a free, 100% local AI-powered command center where AI agents do the heavy lifting while you stay in control. It works alongside your favorite IDE and tools — not as a replacement. It combines LaTeX editing, PDF annotations, reference management, paper discovery, and AI agent orchestration in one desktop application for Windows, macOS, and Linux.

## Who is Sciorex for?

- **Developers**: Agents read, write, and edit files in your codebase. They implement features, fix bugs, and refactor code. You review the changes and continue working in your IDE.
- **Researchers**: Build automated pipelines for paper fetching, summarization, hypothesis generation, and knowledge synthesis. LaTeX editor, PDF annotations, reference library, paper discovery.
- **Teams**: Track work with tickets and epics. Link AI sessions to tasks so everyone sees what the agents did and why.
- **Writers**: Create specialized agents for drafting, editing, fact-checking, and formatting. Chain them together for complete content workflows.
- **Data Analysts**: Explore datasets, generate visualizations, and build analysis pipelines with agents that understand your data.
- **Students**: Organize notes, research topics, and get help understanding complex subjects with personalized AI tutors.
- **Consultants**: Automate client research, competitive analysis, and report generation. Keep everything organized by project.
- **Journalists**: Investigate stories with agents that dig through sources, cross-reference facts, and help uncover connections.

## Documentation

- [Getting Started](https://docs.sciorex.com/getting-started): Installation and setup guide
- [Full Documentation](https://docs.sciorex.com): Complete user and developer documentation
- [MCP Tools Reference](https://docs.sciorex.com/mcp): 59 tools across 6 servers

## Research Features

- LaTeX editor with live PDF preview, bidirectional SyncTeX, and multi-file project support
- PDF annotations: multi-color highlights, margin notes, underline, strikethrough, Markdown export
- Reference library with collections, tags, 11 citation styles, in-text citation formatting, bibliography generation, duplicate detection, BibTeX/RIS/CSL-JSON import/export
- Paper discovery via Semantic Scholar, arXiv, CrossRef with citation network exploration
- 30+ templates: NeurIPS, CVPR, ICLR, Nature, Springer, Elsevier, PhD Thesis, Academic CV
- Select & Ask AI: select any text and get AI explanations, improvements, or translations

## Developer Features

- Vibe kanban: visual task boards for AI coding agents
- Multi-CLI support: Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Codex CLI, OpenCode, LM Studio, Ollama
- Parallel agent execution via isolated git worktrees (no merge conflicts)
- Visual flow editor: 9 node types, conditions, loops, parallel execution, breakpoints, flow execution history, undo/redo, duplication
- Council mode: multi-LLM debate with custom personas (YAML import/export)
- Agent Teams: multi-agent collaboration with specialized roles
- Slash commands, session labels, Find in Chat, session archiving
- 4 chat modes: Agentic, Normal, Preview, Editor; Vim mode; 6 editor themes
- Rich text chat input with markdown formatting, code blocks, and inline file attachments
- 59 MCP tools across 6 servers (Research, Tickets, Resources, Interactions, Secrets, Permissions)
- 45+ keyboard shortcuts, drag-and-drop across kanban/file tree/flow editor/library
- Up to 20 concurrent terminal processes with command history, favorites, and search
- Agent Runs dashboard with session monitoring, costs, and conversation replay
- Embedded VS Code Server for full IDE experience
- Local model management: browse, download, load, and unload from model hub
- Portable mode for Windows (no installation required)

## Key Facts

- Price: Free forever (no subscriptions, no premium tiers, no feature gates)
- Privacy: 100% local, zero data collection, zero telemetry
- Platforms: Windows 10+, macOS 11+ (Intel & Apple Silicon), Linux
- Version: 0.13.0
- License: Proprietary (free for personal and professional use)
